admission.justification: Naming a live same-selection successor prevents lost returns to an archived parent without silently changing recipient authority.

applicability: An id-addressed archived role-message recipient with a later live execution on the same selection.
conditions: Successor resolution is based on recorded selection and actual live status.
exclusions: Developer chat text and native host chat display
Messages via removed earlier orchestration tools
No silent retargeting or unarchive; without a live successor the archived refusal remains.

evidence: SuccessorTests and RegisteredRefusalTests successor cases (L117-C1-F07); checks-attempt4/pytest-focused.log; worker report Attempt 4

statement: An archived recipient id with a live successor on the same selection refuses naming that successor agent, with its id reaching the caller.
